*''For the [[Magic: The Gathering]] expansion, see [[Nemesis (Magic: The Gathering expansion)]].''

'''Nemesis''' is the 50th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on February 10, 2023. The set consists of 55 cards. 

This expansion is designed by lead designer [[Dan Hamman]] and his designer team [[Christoff Wiker]], [[Brian Sykes]] and [[Daniel Matteson]]. 

==Type Breakdown==
*2 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*3 [[:Category:Equipment (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Equipment]]
*3 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]] 
*1 [[:Category:Facility (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Facility]] (1 Romulan)
*11 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
* 3 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]
*1 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*3 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]
* 23 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] ( 1 Borg, 5 Federation, 1 Klingon, 2 Non-Aligned, 11 Romulan, and 3 Vulcan)
*5 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Federation, 3 Romulan, and 1 Vulcan)

'''NOTE:''' There is 1 Dual Affiliations card, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.
